newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FT Holdings seen in HK$57.5 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: FT Holdings seen in HK$57.5 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Christmas tree manufacturer FT Holdings International Ltd is expected to issue 57.5 million new shares at HK$1.00 per share in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong, market sources said on Monday.
"The issue price is expected to represent a P.E. (price to earnings) multiple of about 6.2 times for its fiscal year ended in August 1996," said one analyst who attended a briefing on Monday.

About HK$15 million of the net proceeds is expected to be used to set up a joint venture for manufacturing artificial floral products, and HK$10 million will be used to expand production capacity at FT Holdings' manufacturing plant in Dongguan in China's Guangdong province, market sources said.
The balance is expected to be used for working capital, they added.
CEF Capital and Tai Fook Securities are expected to be the sponsors of the issue, market sources said.
FT Holdings posted a profit of HK$35 million for the year ended August 31, 1996, up from HK$30.6 million in 1995 and HK$27.7 million in 1994.
Turnover increased to HK$150.4 million in 1996 from HK$147.5 million in 1995 and HK$125.9 million in 1994.
Market sources said more than 60 percent of the company's products are for export to the U.S. market, with about 30 percent sold in Hong Kong and the rest exported to Europe and other countries.
